free_tier.stated: Start free with 5,000 credits (USD 1) and no card to start; the Standard 7-day trial grants 50,000 credits (USD 10) but requires adding a card, and converts to USD 20 a month unless cancelled before day 7.
free_tier.notes: 5,000 credits are the free starting balance, not a recurring monthly allowance. A computer is billed per second on provisioned vCPU and memory; a session's 1 vCPU / 1 GiB computer costs 333 credits (USD 0.0666) per running hour, and a 2 vCPU / 4 GiB computer costs USD 0.1656 an hour at published rates.

per_object_cap.stated: The unit is a microVM, not an object. A session's computer is 1 vCPU / 1 GiB; one created directly defaults to 2 vCPU / 4096 MiB, with a range of 1 to 16 vCPU and 128 to 65536 MiB, disk up to 100 GiB.

retention.stated: A computer is disposable: state is ephemeral by default and a destroy tears it down. A snapshot is a durable checkpoint that survives destroy, a persistent volume keeps disk and paused memory across park and sleep but not destroy, and files that must outlive the sandbox are published to Files.

egress.terms: A computer has general outbound access by default with cloud metadata and internal ranges filtered; allow_outbound: false is an immutable kill-switch for all outbound traffic. Nothing reaches in: there is no port-preview surface. No egress price or volume allowance is published.

record.interface_detail: A TypeScript SDK (@usenaive-sdk/managed-agents) and a CLI (naive computer create/exec/fs/snapshot/pause/delete) against the API base URL https://api.vetta.sh with an API key.
record.tooling: The naive CLI and TypeScript SDK create and drive computers; a session's agent reaches the same machine through built-in shell, filesystem and browser tools.
record.chaining: A computer pauses between agent turns and wakes on the next operation, so a multi-hour task pays only for running seconds; publish_file moves artifacts out to organization-scoped Files that outlive the sandbox.

limits.value: 5,000 free credits (USD 1) at start; vCPU USD 0.000014 per second and memory USD 0.0000045 per GiB-second, with no creation fee
the Standard 7-day trial requires a card and grants 50,000 credits; every route outside billing needs an active plan, and a paused computer resumes only if the balance covers one 10-minute block
12-hour maximum runtime from create to destroy, fixed with no per-computer override; the computer is auto-destroyed at the ceiling

record.limits_note: A computer you create is billed in advance in 10-minute blocks; a session's computer is billed per running second. The browser is capped at 360 minutes per session. Automatic destroy at zero balance and per-organization concurrency caps are not enforced yet.
record.binding_note: The USD 1 starting credit runs out first: it buys about 15 hours of a session's 1 vCPU / 1 GiB computer or about 6 hours of the 2 vCPU / 4 GiB default, both shorter than the 12-hour runtime ceiling.

identity_cost.detail: The register page at app.usenaive.ai/register renders an Email field and a terms agreement; the onboarding manifest documents 'naive auth register --email ... --password ...' with a confirmation mail, and states an account starts at 0 credits until a plan is chosen. No card is needed to start free, but the 7-day Standard trial and any paid plan require a card.

record.reliability_note: Automatic destroy at zero balance and after the maximum runtime is not enforced yet, so a user must delete a computer when finished; cloud metadata, 10.0.0.0/8 and 172.16.0.0/12 are blocked but 192.168.0.0/16 is not reliably blocked, so private-range blocking is not a security boundary for the shell.
record.confidence_note: The computer price, egress behaviour and lifecycle are quoted from the vendor's launch post read on 2026-11-25; the free credits, trial card gate and 12-hour ceiling are from the vendor pricing and limits pages on the same date.

record.category: managed AI agent platform with hosted computers

free_tier.stated: Start free with 5,000 credits to try the whole team; no card to start. Standard then costs $20 a month with 100,000 credits a month; a separate Standard 7-day trial requires a card.
free_tier.notes: The hosted computer is charged 252 credits per vCPU-hour and 81 credits per GiB-hour, so 5,000 credits pays for about 15 hours of the 1 vCPU / 1 GiB session computer at 333 credits an hour, within its 12-hour cap. Credits roll over and do not expire.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is an agent's computer, not an object; a file read or write is 4 MiB per call, publish_file or fetch_file moves up to 5 GiB per file, and shell output is 262,144 characters per stream

retention.stated: Included credit rolls over and never expires; a computer is auto-destroyed at 12 hours from create, and when its balance cannot pay the next 10-minute block it is paused with its disk kept.

egress.terms: The hosted computer runs on the platform; no outbound data volume allowance or per-TB price is published. Agent email is 4 credits per send however many recipients, web_fetch about 4 credits per page and web_search about 8 credits, and each phone-minute includes the residential network the traffic exits through.

record.interface_detail: Agents are driven from the studio chat and a REST API such as POST /v1/agents and /v1/computers, with a naive command line tool; computer files and shell are reached through the API's file and shell routes.
record.tooling: the studio, the REST API and the naive CLI; an agent's computer runs commands and files through the API and a browser, phone and mobile device can be attached to it
record.chaining: One company plan covers all agents with no per-person fee, and the same credit balance pays model inference, the hosted computer, web tools, media and phone minutes; files must be published off the computer with publish_file before its 12-hour auto-destroy.

limits.value: 12 hours maximum computer runtime from create to destroy; no per-computer override
5,000 credits to start, at 333 credits per hour for the 1 vCPU / 1 GiB session computer
4 MiB per file read or write call; 5 GiB per publish_file or fetch_file; 262,144 characters per shell output stream

record.limits_note: A computer you create yourself is billed ahead in 10-minute blocks and needs a balance covering one block to create or resume; a session's computer is metered per running second. There is no count limit on computers, only the balance.
record.binding_note: The 12-hour fixed lifetime with no override ends a long-running job whatever the balance, before the free credit or the per-call file cap is spent.

identity_cost.detail: Registration is by email and starts with 5,000 credits and no card; a Google or other social option is not shown on the signup page. A card is required only for the 7-day Standard trial, and one trial is allowed per organization and per person.

record.reliability_note: A computer is paused when its balance cannot cover the next 10-minute block and is auto-destroyed at 12 hours; an unfunded mobile device is ended with termination_reason unfunded, and a data or social data run past two minutes is stopped.
record.confidence_note: The free grant, credit rate, card-free signup and paid prices are quoted from the vendor's pricing and registration pages read on 2026-11-24; the runtime ceiling, metering and per-object caps are quoted from its own documentation.
